You work as a freelance reporter. Late one evening, you are sitting at your tablet while the news reports on a death at a nearby estate. Shortly afterwards, a police officer friend calls you and tells you that the investigation into the case is closed for the moment and the crime scene is unguarded. You immediately set off to write the story of your life.

You grab your equipment and drive to a forest parking lot near the crime scene. There you find the first clues that the extent of this family tragedy appears to be far greater than you first suspected.

notes.title: Hotfix - Hosting
notes.content:
Fixed:
- Fixed that a server could be created without meta data and as a result no further servers could be hosted until it was closed.

notes.title: Update v1.04
notes.content:
Changes:
- Added a note in the "Office" level to explain symbols ingame in case the player does not know them.
- Added a note in the Host menu that "Steam Invites" are not implemented and clients must use the in-game menu to join servers.

Fixes:
Adjusted the spawn point in the "Office" level slightly to prevent clients from spawning in weird places on very rare cases.

notes.title: Update v1.03
notes.content:
Changes:
- The position of the table in the corner behind the room dividers in the Level Office has been adjusted slightly so that items can no longer be accidentally thrown behind it.

Fixes:
- Fixed that clients that were automatically kicked out of the end screen (By closing the server by the host) could not move in the following level after joining.
- Fixed a bug that allowed an action to be triggered in the level Office that was supposed to be available only after solving a puzzle.

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.content: Fixed a bug that resulted in only the host being able to see the hints diary in the Level Office.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixes:
- Fixed a bug where items could be dropped upside down in investigation mode. This resulted in items no longer being able to be picked up.

notes.title: Update v1.02
notes.content:
Features:
- Implemented a way to drop held items upside down. 

Fixes:
- Fixed that in rare cases, clients could no longer pick up items even though they were not holding anything in their hand.
- Fixed that the host could not drop larger items when looking downwards.

notes.title: Update v1.01
notes.content:
- A hint diary has been added. Here, requested hints can be read again. In addition, the hints for already completed puzzles are also displayed here.
- Some players seem not to have seen the hint feature, so now a welcome message points it out.
- A Steam Achievement has been renamed.

notes.title: Hotfix v1
notes.content:
- Fixed Motion Blur (Sorry !!)
- Added FPS Limiter (see ingame options)
- Fixed a problem with a riddle in "Apartment" in German localization
